ICEYE and Rheinmetall Win €1.7 Billion German Armed Forces Contract
articles.summary:
The German Armed Forces have awarded a €1.7 billion contract to Rheinmetall and ICEYE for the delivery of space-based reconnaissance data through exclusive access to a synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite constellation.
